draftAnswer: (Draft) In the product, the adviser answers only with what you know at this moment; when you ask what someone else will think, it says it is a guess. Asking does not move time, and the world does not change because of it.
title: Ask the adviser
note: Time does not move · inside the play it knows only what you know; outside, it can look things up online
busy: The adviser is looking it up…
placeholder: Ask the adviser: who will react how, where the risk is in this step…
empty: Ask anything you want to be clear on before you decide. Asking is only asking: the world does not move because of it. To act, choose a way in the next step above or write your own move.
redirected: What you wrote as a move was a question, so it is answered here and time did not move
